title: Trash
description: Deleted records (contacts, companies, deals, products, activities, quotes and custom objects) stay here until they are purged. Restore one to bring it back with its links.
purgeDescription: The record's values, notes, attachments and tags will be erased. This cannot be undone.
emptyDescription: Deleted records show up here until they are purged.
emptyFiltered: No deleted record matches the search.

retention.title: Time in the trash
retention.description: After this period, deleted records are erased by a daily routine.
retention.label: Days in the trash
